## comando
```sh
cd /home/one/projects/one/ai-guides/protocols/telegram_bots_guide; ls -l 08-python-python-telegram-bot.md 09-python-aiogram.md 10-python-pytelegrambotapi.md; python3 - <<'PY'
import re, os
files=['08-python-python-telegram-bot.md','09-python-aiogram.md','10-python-pytelegrambotapi.md']
repos='/tmp/telegram-research/repos'; pages='/tmp/telegram-research/pages'
def resolve(p):
    if p=='bots/api.md': return pages+'/bots_api.md.md'
    if p.startswith('bots/api/methods/'): return pages+'/api/'+p.split('/')[-1]
    return os.path.join(repos,p)
for f in files:
    s=open(f).read(); lines=s.splitlines()
    cites=set(re.findall(r'`([A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(?:py|rst|md))(?::([0-9,\-]+))?`', s))
    bad=[]
    for path,spec in cites:
        full=resolve(path)
        if not os.path.exists(full): bad.append(('MISSING',path)); continue
        if not spec: continue
        n=sum(1 for _ in open(full,errors='replace'))
        for part in spec.split(','):
            if '-' in part:
                a,b=map(int,part.split('-',1))
                if a<1 or b>n or a>b: bad.append(('RANGE',path,spec,n))
            else:
                v=int(part)
                if v<1 or v>n: bad.append(('LINE',path,spec,v,n))
    srcs=[l for l in lines if l.startswith('- http')]
    print(f'{f}: {len(s.encode())} bytes; first={lines[0]!r}; last section={[l for l in lines if l.startswith("## ")][-1]!r}; sources={len(srcs)}; citations={len(cites)}; problems={bad}')
PY
```
